analysis:
Both changed files are documentation only (docs/architecture/hardware-support.md, docs/architecture/inference.md). I found no code, config, key-handling, attestation, or wire-protocol changes, so no control is weakened and no new attack surface appears.

hardware-support.md adds a systemAvailable formula (head lines 248-253) for the `reclaimable` policy. It counts page cache and purgeable pages, never anonymous or compressor pages. This describes load-admission memory accounting. It is availability-relevant, not a confidentiality or authorization control. The ordinary atomic pending-load permit, post-load KV headroom probe and MLX caps stay described as authoritative. The doc does not claim to change any T-0xx mitigation. I did not verify whether the described implementation matches the docs.

inference.md patch (hunks at head lines 810-813, 829, 876-895, 1732-1751) has these changes:
- GLM variable-frame-rate video is now indexed instead of rejected as a 400. This is a decode-path behavior change that reads frames within the existing 512 MiB decoded-frame cap and the 28,532 visual-token cap, so bounded resource use is documented. DoS or parser robustness of AVFoundation on attacker-supplied video (consumer-supplied, TB-003/T-050 area) cannot be verified from docs alone.
- Documented GLM response_format, strict tools and forced tool_choice are enforced by post-validation (ToolConstraintValidation, GLM5NextResponseFormat), with the output withheld until validated and invalid output returned as a 422 with no content. This fails closed per the doc.
- nativeOutputControlRefusal refuses unsupported token-constraint and logprob rows on protected native engines with a 400 before reservation. This avoids the 500 generation_failure that strikes the inference-error breaker (T-010 availability-adjacent). It is a mitigation, not a regression.

There is no impact on T-041 prefix-cache (media excluded from prefix lookup and capture, unchanged), the E2E encryption path (T-008), or TB-011 authorization.

Next pass should confirm that the source implementing these doc claims (GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset, EngineV2Bridge+Submission.swift, SystemMemory.availableBytes) matches, if those files are in the PR. They are not in the supplied evidence.
